company.name: Moviedom
company.shortDescription: MovieDOM is a blockchain-powered entertainment ecosystem designed to revolutionize how films, events, and digital content are funded.
company.description:
MovieDOM is building an open, borderless entertainment ecosystem designed to empower filmmakers, musicians, and fans to collaboratively own and shape the future of content creation.

The platform’s vision centers on decentralizing the entertainment industry by enabling creators and audiences to participate directly in the development, funding, and success of creative projects. By fostering co-ownership and community-driven collaboration, MovieDOM aims to create a more inclusive and transparent model for the next generation of entertainment.

Through this approach, the company seeks to strengthen connections between creators and fans while unlocking new opportunities for participation, engagement, and shared value creation across film, music, and digital media.
